messages:
maya_cs: Heads-up — DeltaHealth renewal needs final sign + wire. Terms updated to 9mo, +12 seats (prorated). They asked for EU entity signer and a separate remit for VAT. Need signoff timeline so finance can schedule the wire. Attach: https://our-drive/DeltaHealth/so_w_revA.pdf :paperclip:

alex_fin: Got it. Finance can accept a wire, but we need the PO and invoice match by EOD 2026-04-10 to hit their treasury cutoff. If PO arrives late, wire will fall to next cycle (4/15). :alarm_clock:

julie_legal: Quick notes from legal: EU signer must be listed on the SOW with explicit billing entity. Also need a signing delegate form if signer's not on file. I can draft the delegate template — will that delay by a day?

ethan_se: Maya — can you confirm whether the customer is sending a new PO with the 12 seats, or will they amend? I need to know for invoice lines.

maya_cs: They said they'd send an amended PO. I asked ops to expedite. I’ll ping procurement contact: @sam_ae — can you join the thread?

sam_ae: On it. I’ll reach out to the customer now and confirm the PO header & billing entity. ETA 2 hours. Also flagging the VAT remit — they might want an invoice split.

julie_legal: If they insist on split invoices, we need the legal entity mapping before printing docs. Otherwise DocuSign will show the wrong billing name.

maya_cs: To keep everyone aligned, proposed plan: (1) Sam confirms PO/billing entity by 14:30 UTC, (2) Legal issues delegate form if needed by EOD, (3) Finance schedules wire for 4/12 if PO matches. Who owns DocuSign routing?

ethan_se: I can own the DocuSign routing — I’ll set up a canary send to internal alias first. Can you drop the signers and order?

maya_cs: Signer order requested by customer: 1) EU CFO (primary), 2) Local Ops (witness), 3) Redwood exec.

alex_fin: For wire metadata — please use the following invoice stub format so treasury reconciles quickly:

```
Invoice: RWI-2026-0427-DELTA
Amount: EUR 78,450.00
PO: [will be inserted]
```

bank details: `acct ****1234, SWIFT: RBWDDEFF` (we'll send full details via secure doc).

docsign-bot: Reminder: DocuSign envelope created by ethan_se will require signing order. If delegate required, attach "delegate_authorization.pdf" to the envelope.

julie_legal: FYI — small catch: the customer's EU CFO needs proof of KYC for entity. Sam, please ask for KYC docs in the same email to avoid back-and-forth.

sam_ae: Will do. Also asking them to cc finance@deltahealth.com to speed treasury matching.

maya_cs: Perfect. If PO + KYC come in by 14:30 UTC I'll loop legal for delegate and ethan for DocuSign routing. Otherwise we'll need to push wire to the 4/15 cycle. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ethan_se: Once I get the PO + verified billing name I'll create the envelope and post back the envelope id.

alex_fin: Finance note: if they request split invoice we need final line items by 4/11 09:00 PT. Otherwise we can proceed on single invoice.

maya_cs: Thanks team. I'll post updates here. Standing by for Sam's confirmation. :thumbsup:
